Aspen Kartier And Lady BL Remember Their Last Memory Of #BloodHoundQ50 💔🕊️

BloodHound Q50 was a rising Chicago drill rapper whose real name was Mikquale T. Cooper. He began taking music seriously around 2023 and built momentum through songs including “Big 3,” “Coffin,” “Splash Bros,” “Triple 3,” “BH4L,” and “Don’t Blink Or Stare.” He was closely associated musically with Bloodhound Lil Jeff, Lil Scoom89, Rell Vert and other artists from Chicago’s newer drill generation. Q50 later signed with Signal Records and released projects including Long Live My Brudda He Prolly Kilt Yo Brudda in 2025 and Get Back or Die Trying in August 2026. Q50 d* on September 13, 2026, at 22 years old following a shooting in Chicago’s Fuller Park neighborhood.

Aspen Kartier is a rising Chicago rapper and social media personality who has built a large following through her music, TikTok presence, and personality online. She’s part of Chicago’s newer generation of female rap talent and has released tracks including “Pretty,” “They Be Hiding,” and “Percocet Love” featuring TopOppGen. Her TikTok presence has grown to well over 700,000 followers, helping her music reach an audience beyond Chicago. She has also collaborated with artists including Mello Buckzz and Lady Binladen. 

Lady BL is Lady Binladen, another rising Chicago rapper and social media personality. She has developed a following through TikTok and her music, mixing her personality-driven social content with releases and freestyles. Her music includes collaborations with Aspen Kartier, and she recently appeared for a FireHouse Studios freestyle under the Lady Binladen name. Her TikTok presence under Lady BL has grown to more than 300,000 followers.
